# Pods4Rail_Topology

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A modular rail-system network topology where pods (self-contained units) form reconfigurable communication clusters with SDN-managed inter-pod links. Provides a real-world testbed for TCC/iNEST research on adaptive topology reconfiguration and neuromorphic-inspired routing under mobility constraints.
